task: round 13 skeptic v_hyp_node_count R13NC-6 (low-mean-p component prune)
reason: The VALUE claim does not hold up, and the candidate is not worth doing before R8. (1) It is mislabelled. The new check (scratchpad r13v6/sent.py -> sent_out.json, all 56 ins35 clips) shows that ALL 478 selected components contain edge_prob == 0.0 sentinel edges. Those are relink/readmit pairs the edge network never scored (CONTEXT l.1325, l.1511). 465/478 hold readmitted nodes. The share of zero-p edges in the selected bins is 26-65%, while the median mean NONZERO p is 0.62 (p10 0.56). So 'mean p < 0.5' is really 'short (median 7 nodes) readmitted/relinked component'. That makes it a readmit/relink drop in disguise: the readmit drop is lab +0.00049 but 44b6 -0.00233, and the relink-override edge filter is CLOSED (+0.016 lab -> 0 on LB). The network is not saying these are bad. (2) W/L 48/1 is mechanical. Only 4 clips (all 6bba) have any matched node or FP-edge change (dFP -2/-6/-2/-4, dTP -2). Every other 'win' is the pure node term from deleting unmatched nodes, which wins any clip by construction. The 44b6 +0.00028 is 100% node term with 0 matched. (3) The lab is in-sample: the detector and edge net were trained on all 199 train videos (CONTEXT l.1071, l.1350). The low TP cost (0.08 TP edges per matched node) is the memorisation artefact that killed the edge filter. Enrichment r is already 0.17-0.20, about 4x above the break-even r* 0.047, so any out-of-sample TP cost flips the sign. (4) The cliff is close. Node share by component mean p: [0.5, 0.55) 0.61%, [0.55, 0.6) 1.45%, [0.6, 0.65) 3.19%, [0.65, 0.7) 6.74%. A -0.05 shift in p, or more sentinel edges on unseen data, roughly triples the selection, and -0.15 moves toward the 0.7 arm (12.4% of nodes, -0.0129). (5) The size is invisible: +0.0006 lab (+0.0015 stacked with lp30, which is already in flight as probe 40) is about +0.0001-0.00025 public, below the 0.001 display step. The same class (P36 leaf prune) displayed 0. FEASIBILITY: it needs a new builder patch, tests, a byte-identical-when-off check, a dummy and a NEW user OK before 27 Sep 12:00 UTC (R8). It has no honest out-of-embryo gate, because both train embryos are in-sample. It fails R8 on value/bar (+0.012 lab / +0.002 public), not on runtime.
fix: Do not build or submit before the deadline. Post-deadline, re-label it as 'short readmitted-component drop' and define the selector on network-scored edges only (exclude edge_prob == 0.0 sentinels from the mean), with a node-fraction cap of 0.5% per clip. Gate it on an out-of-sample edge net (leave-one-embryo-out retrain) or on late-submission private scores, never on the in-sample train lab. Otherwise fold it into the readmit threshold (READMIT_MIN_SCORE) study instead of adding a new pruning stage.
realistic_gain: About +0.0001 public (0 on the display) and between -0.001 and +0.0003 private. The sign is not established out of sample: the in-sample lab says +0.0006, and the readmit-drop sibling is negative on 44b6. Effective pre-deadline gain: 0.
